description: This file implements a PostgreSQL-backed vector store with methods for setting, getting, deleting, and searching vector records, including handling of metadata and vector similarity metrics.

classes.name: postgresVectorStore
classes.description: A struct representing a PostgreSQL-backed vector store with methods for vector operations.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Stores or updates a vector record in the database.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a vector record by scope, scopeID, and key.

methods.name: DeleteByPrefix
methods.description: Deletes vector records with keys matching a prefix.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Performs a vector similarity search with optional filters.
